card.name: Place words ending a location phrase
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "Cities" after "Twin" in Minnesota climate text, and a few words like "here" or "the" that complete a place or setting phrase. It also fires on a few unrelated word endings, such as inhal-er and delt-oid.

modes.label: Twin Cities
modes.description: The word Cities (or Twin) in the name Twin Cities, in weather record text.
modes.example: 139 years of Twin<< Cities>> temperature data were reviewed.

modes.label: Place words like here
modes.description: The word "here" or "the" finishing a phrase about a location or region.
modes.example: 5,000 wild turkeys have been trapped<< here>> and relocated

modes.label: Partway through medical words
modes.description: The ending of a device or muscle word such as inhaler or deltoid.
modes.example: The dose counter will count down each time the inhal<<er>> is actuated.
